    Grimmel Peninsula¶

    The southern peninsula of Erisdar — a contested, politically fragmented landmass projecting into the seas south of the Erisian Empire. Named for the Grimmel Republic, the peninsula's central power.

    Seas¶

    • Venner Sea — west of the peninsula, dominated by the Vennerian Trade Republic
    • Eris Sea — east of the peninsula, named for Eris

    The Three Layers (north → south)¶

    1. Erisian Empire — the peninsula's northern edge: the Empire's southern counties and order states (Ever Order, Draco Order, and the counties of Laber, Rivel, Marshgress, Matelofn, Opamer, Nortpos, Swineber, Marshloi, Dryle, Aspenwat, Rustred, Duvlon, Miwat).
    2. Grimmel Republic — the central heartland, surrounded by independent nations: Wrothri, Duchy of Meadle, Rudialand, Manoco, Charia, Lukka, Limese League, Pinc Republic, Ferroson, Arisdian, Tundranya, Cronia, Lamoro, Elkenloft, Obsidian Dwarnov, Migah, Mystili, Limnya, Malinya, Cerulea, Aelefer.
    3. Scarlet Order — the south: a martial-religious order-state holding Koel Order, Nortrasdor, Asheng, Centaapoli, Syacmori, Evern, Linitra, Elmfer, Romanium Dwarnov, with the Order of Niccas and Tarol offshore.

    Vennerian Presence¶

    The eastern reach of the Vennerian Trade Republic: Aelefer (land territory), Melior (region near the Order of Niccas).

    Connections¶

    • Region: South Erisdar
    • North: Erisian Empire
    • Central: Grimmel Republic
    • South: Scarlet Order
    • West Sea: Venner Sea
    • East Sea: Eris Sea
    • Religion: Apostles of Eris — Alexa, Draco, Niccas, Ever institutions
